question: How must a foreign educational credential be assessed?

claims.text: A foreign educational credential must be assessed by a designated organization so its Canadian equivalency and authenticity can be established.
claims.quote: ECA reports include the designated organization’s assessment of the authenticity of the applicant’s completed foreign educational credentials.

basis: Educational Credential Assessment document (case ID: 3ae82acc1b3cf1589d70a7579dbff92a) submitted under upload-slot type educational_credential_assessment: World Education Services ECA report WES-4920183/ECA issued 2024-03-15 for Master of Science in Data Science from University of Manchester, United Kingdom.
